decision.explanation: The original source D2S2 explicitly states 'Sony has announced that God of War will be released for PS4 on April 20, 2018.' This directly supports the release date of *God of War (2018)*. The other references either mention unrelated dates (e.g., Jan 23, 2018) or refer to a different version of the game (e.g., April 2, 2011). The audit records confirm direct support from D2S2 with no conflicting claims about the same referent.
